scope: Post-freeze development priorities; diagnostic cases are now known regressions, not new reserved validation

priorities.problem: Parent identity and prior child selection do not establish delivery of the current question's decisive subsection
priorities.action: Select current-detail relevant complete children and qualified companions within canonical identity and evidence budgets; preserve exact pin restrictions and record unresolved dependencies
priorities.acceptance: Inspect actual writer requests for complete governing text; a retrieved source ID or verifier pass alone is insufficient

priorities.problem: Quality guards consume unrelated discovered zoning sources and structured tables
priorities.action: Scope each legal/table/definition guard to the active question and the claims and evidence it governs; retain checks for genuine unsupported conclusions and incomplete table bindings
priorities.acceptance: Known correct narrow answers survive irrelevant evidence without allowing unsupported zoning claims

priorities.problem: Narrow revision cannot edit citation relevance even though that field can contain rejected legal claims
priorities.action: Expose citation explanatory text as an identified bounded edit target while keeping source identities and authoritative text immutable; freshly verify the complete repaired answer
priorities.acceptance: An unnecessary definition attribution is removed from every narrative location without dropping a still-required operative citation

priorities.problem: A correct main answer can be suppressed by an unnecessary method overview after bounded revision
priorities.action: Prefer the narrow requested conclusion and complete material conditions; evaluate whether a bounded source-checked removal repair can preserve supported claims without ignoring a substantive defect
priorities.acceptance: Every retained legal claim is checked against supplied complete evidence; partial verified conclusions are distinguished from unresolved design choices

priorities.problem: Some custom numeric project facts remain as stale semantic query hints after a current correction
priorities.action: Extend correction shadowing to labeled custom facts conservatively; keep current user values, hypothetical scope and existing-property inventory distinct
priorities.acceptance: Corrected dimensions do not coexist with contradicted saved values as active query premises; unrelated facts remain available

priorities.problem: A diagnostic replay and a current local source snapshot do not establish reliable hosted performance or current enacted authority
priorities.action: After generic fixes, freeze a new candidate and unused ordinary-language multi-turn cohort; continue source-version ingestion, changed-text reindexing, cache invalidation, durable semantic spend accounting and hosted browser acceptance
priorities.acceptance: Separate decisive-text recall, interpretation, delivered correctness, sustained family success, cost and latency; require professional review before broad accuracy claims
